extraction_notes: Fiscal deficit, revenue deficit, and primary deficit are reported as positive magnitudes, converting from negative values in the report which indicate a deficit. The report mentions 'effective Fiscal Deficit of the State was 3.13 per cent of GSDP' and an adjusted debt-to-GSDP ratio of 30.24% after audit examination (page 33), but the primary summary tables (Table 1.6, Chart 1.8, Table 2.28) report 3.28% and 23.95% respectively. The unadjusted figures are used as per the instruction to report directly stated values from summary tables. The outstanding_debt_crore is taken from 'Outstanding overall Debt' in Table 2.28, which includes Public Account Liabilities, aligning with the debt_pct_gsdp figure. No direct figures for audit paras (raised this year, outstanding over 5 years, PAC recommendations pending, money value of observations) were found in the report.
